item.title: 2026-11-02 · Agenda item 12.D. Public Hearing and Resolution Approving the Final Site Plan SPR-26-04 for Site Improvements and a Parking Lot Expansion at Gaspar's Patio Bar and Grille
item.description: SPR-26-04 is largely a plan to extend off-street commercial parking into a contiguous residentially zoned area. Section 12-293(1) of the Land Development Code allows for such an extension up to 100' from the commercial property. SPR-26-04, as submitted, relies on Council's approval of a waiver of the standards defined in Section 12-293(1) to allow for the parking to be extended to just over 175' from the commercial use. Hillsborough County City-County Planning Commission staff finds this waiver to be inconsistent with the City's Comprehensive Plan. The granting of the waiver, or its denial, is at the discretion of City Council.

item.title: 2026-01-20 · Agenda item 12.A. First Public Hearing and First Reading of an Ordinance Amending the Comprehensive Plan Future Land Use Map Designation for 5416 and 5418 Rainbow Drive (CPA -24-01) (Continued from 10/21/25) (Application has been withdrawn- Item is not moving forward)
item.description: Upon review of several factors related to the proposed amendment, most notably: 1) The Planning Commission Staff Report recommendation of inconsistency, 2) The Planning Commission's adoption of Resolution TT/CPA 24-01 with a finding of inconsistency, 3) A detailed review of Future Land Use Plan Locational Factors and Policies, and 4) In consideration of preserving the character of the affected single-family neighborhood district, the Community Development Department agrees that this amendment is inconsistent with the long-range future planning goals and objectives of Temple Terrace and therefore cannot recommend approval of this ordinance.

item.title: 2026-01-20 · Agenda item 12.B. First Public Hearing and First Reading of an Ordinance to Rezone 5416 and 5418 Rainbow Drive (RZP-24-03) from Residential-10 (R-10) to Commercial General (CG) (Continued from 10/21/25) (Application has been withdrawn - Item is not moving forward)
item.description: Based upon the current Comprehensive Plan Future Land Use Map designation, the proposed rezoning to Commercial General is inconsistent with the underlying land use designation and, therefore, is dependent upon a land use designation amendment to allow for commercial uses. Additionally, the Community Development Department supports the Planning Commission Staff Report, which concludes that the proposed C-G district is inconsistent with the Future Land Use Plan at this location. The Planning Commission Staff Report included in the attachments provides several policies to support a finding of inconsistency.
